q: ---- quantum computing is still a young discipline, its mathematical roots go back more than a century.
explain: Genç ↔ eski zaman zıtlığı var; zıtlık bağlacı Although. Because/So that neden-amaç, Unless koşul.
tip: Yeni ↔ eski, az ↔ çok gibi kutup zıtlığını ara.

q: Steel is strong and cheap; ----, it rusts quickly when exposed to seawater.
explain: Olumlu (güçlü, ucuz) → olumsuz (paslanır) kutup değişimi; however. Therefore sonuç, moreover ekleme.
tip: Noktalı virgülden sonra kutup değişiyorsa however/nevertheless.

q: ---- its small size, the new sensor can detect gas leaks from a distance of fifty metres.
explain: Boşluktan sonra isim öbeği (its small size) var; zıtlık + isim = Despite. Although cümle ister.
tip: Ardından isim varsa despite/in spite of; cümle varsa although.

q: ---- older bridges were designed for horse-drawn carts, modern ones must carry heavy lorries.
explain: Eski köprü ↔ modern köprü karşılaştırması; whereas iki tarafı karşılaştırır. Since neden olurdu, anlam bozulur.

q: The first prototype was heavy and noisy, ---- the second one was light and almost silent.
explain: Ağır/gürültülü ↔ hafif/sessiz: iki prototip karşılaştırılıyor; while (oysa).
tip: Virgülden sonra zıt özellik varsa while/whereas.

q: The results of the trial were encouraging; ----, the researchers warned that the sample size was too small.
explain: Olumlu sonuç → uyarı (olumsuz): nevertheless. Consequently sonuç anlamı verir, uyarı sonuç değil.

q: ---- copper is an excellent conductor, it is rarely used for long-distance power lines because of its weight and cost.
explain: İletken (olumlu) ↔ nadiren kullanılır (olumsuz): Even though. Since neden kurar, anlam çelişir.
tip: Cümle başında zıtlık için even though/although.

q: Solar panels produce no emissions while operating; ----, their production requires large amounts of energy.
explain: Emisyonsuz (olumlu) ↔ üretim enerji ister (olumsuz): on the other hand. In other words yeniden ifade eder, zıtlık değil.
tip: Bir konunun iki yüzü anlatılıyorsa on the other hand.

q: The alloy performed well in laboratory tests, ---- it failed within weeks under real operating conditions.
explain: Laboratuvarda iyi ↔ gerçekte başarısız: yet (ama). So/hence/thus sonuç; for (çünkü) neden.

q: ---- the Moon has almost no atmosphere, the Earth is surrounded by a thick layer of gases.
explain: Ay atmosfersiz ↔ Dünya kalın atmosfer: karşılaştırma bağlacı While cümle başında da kullanılır.
tip: While cümle başında hem 'iken' hem 'oysa' olabilir; anlamdan karar ver.

q: ---- heavy rain, the engineers completed the foundation work on schedule.
explain: Ardından isim (heavy rain) var: In spite of. Although/Even though/Whereas cümle ister.
tip: Bağlaç mı edat mı? Önce boşluktan sonrasına bak.

q: Diamond is the hardest natural material; ----, graphite, which is also pure carbon, is soft enough to write with.
explain: Sert ↔ yumuşak: by contrast. Similarly benzerlik, ters anlam.
tip: İki şey zıt özellik gösteriyorsa by contrast/in contrast.

q: The theory explains most of the observations, ---- it cannot account for the unusual behaviour of the outer planets.
explain: Çoğunu açıklar ↔ bazısını açıklayamaz: but. As/since/because neden bildirir.

q: ---- the virus was identified decades ago, an effective vaccine has only recently become available.
explain: Onlarca yıl önce ↔ ancak yakın zamanda: zaman zıtlığı, Although. Once 'bir kez -ince' anlamı mantıksız.
tip: Eski ↔ yeni zaman zıtlığı da zıtlık bağlacı ister.

q: The method is expensive; ----, it remains the most reliable way of detecting cracks inside metal parts.
explain: Pahalı (olumsuz) ↔ en güvenilir (olumlu): nonetheless. Hence sonuç anlamı yanlış.
tip: Olumsuz → olumlu dönüşte de zıtlık bağlacı gerekir.

q: Mercury is a metal; ----, unlike most metals, it is liquid at room temperature.
explain: Metal ama sıvı: beklentiye ters, however. Therefore/thus/as a result sonuç.

q: Some bacteria are harmful, ---- many others are essential for digestion.
explain: Zararlı ↔ gerekli: whereas.

q: The building survived the earthquake ---- its age, which surprised many structural engineers.
explain: İsim öbeği (its age) öncesi zıtlık edatı: despite. Although cümle ister.

q: ---- most early computers filled entire rooms, today's smartphones are far more powerful.
explain: Eski devasa ↔ bugünkü küçük ama güçlü: While (oysa).

q: Wind power is cheap and clean; it is, ----, unreliable on calm days.
explain: Ucuz/temiz ↔ güvenilmez: cümle ortasında however. Therefore/thus sonuç.
tip: However cümle ortasında virgüller arasında da gelebilir.

q: The drug reduced symptoms in mice; ----, it had no measurable effect on human patients.
explain: Farelerde etkili ↔ insanlarda etkisiz: in contrast. Similarly zıt anlam verir.
tip: İki grubun zıt sonucu: in contrast.

q: ---- they are both gases at room temperature, oxygen supports combustion while nitrogen does not.
explain: Her ikisi gaz (benzerlik) ↔ davranış farklı: Although. Because/since mantık hatası.

q: The concrete was covered with plastic sheets ---- it would not dry too quickly.
explain: Amaç cümlesi + would: so that. Although zıtlık.

q: Samples were stored at −80 °C ---- prevent the proteins from breaking down.
explain: Boşluktan sonra yalın fiil (prevent): in order to. So that cümle ister, due to isim ister.
tip: in order to + V1; so that + cümle.

q: The laboratory was redesigned with a view to ---- the risk of chemical spills.
explain: With a view to + Ving: reducing. 'to' burada edat, yalın fiil gelmez.
tip: with a view to = in order to, ama ardından Ving.

q: The flight was cancelled ---- strong winds over the runway.
explain: Ardından isim öbeği (strong winds): because of. Because cümle ister.
tip: Neden + isim = because of / due to / owing to.

q: ---- oil prices rose sharply in the 1970s, many countries began investing in nuclear power.
explain: Yükselen fiyat → nükleere yatırım: neden ilişkisi, As (çünkü).

q: Heat cannot escape from the inner layer; ----, the core temperature keeps rising.
explain: Isı kaçamıyor → sıcaklık artıyor: sonuç, consequently. Nevertheless zıtlık.
tip: Birinci cümle nedense ikinci sonuçsa consequently/therefore.

q: The coating reflects most sunlight, ---- keeping the building cool in summer.
explain: Virgülden sonra Ving ile sonuç: thus + Ving. Despite isim alır ama anlam zıt.

q: The valve releases excess steam, ---- preventing the boiler from exploding.
explain: Thereby + Ving = böylece. Whereby 'ki onunla' (cümle ister), so that cümle ister.

q: ---- water expands when it freezes, rocks crack after repeated cold nights.
explain: Donunca genişler → kaya çatlar: neden, Since.
tip: Since: hem 'beri' hem 'çünkü'; zaman ifadesi yoksa neden.

q: The plant was shut down ---- a dangerous leak should occur during the storm.
explain: Korkusuyla + cümle (should occur): for fear that. so as to/in order to fiil ister, owing to/thanks to isim.
tip: lest / for fear that + should + V1.

q: Many species are disappearing ---- the loss of their natural habitats.
explain: Ardından isim öbeği: due to. Because cümle ister.

q: The results were unreliable ---- the instruments had not been calibrated properly.
explain: Güvenilmez çünkü kalibre edilmemiş: since + cümle. Despite isim alır, zıt anlam.

q: The new engine burns less fuel; ----, it produces fewer emissions.
explain: Az yakıt → az emisyon: sonuç, hence. However zıtlık.

q: Engineers added more sensors so as ---- small changes in pressure.
explain: so as + to V1: to detect.
tip: so as to / in order to + V1.

q: The bridge was closed ---- engineers could inspect the damaged cables.
explain: Ardından tam cümle (engineers could inspect): so that. so as to/in order to fiil, with a view to Ving ister.

q: ---- the high cost of platinum, researchers are looking for cheaper catalysts.
explain: İsim öbeği önünde neden edatı: Owing to. Since/Because cümle ister.
tip: owing to = due to = because of.

q: Graphene is unusual ---- it conducts electricity better than copper while being almost transparent.
explain: "…-dığı için/bakımından" anlamı: in that. So that/in order that amaç bildirir.

q: Fresh water is scarce in the region; ----, desalination plants have been built along the coast.
explain: Kıtlık → tesis kuruldu: sonuç, therefore. Nevertheless/in spite of this zıtlık.
tip: Sorun → çözüm ilişkisi genelde sonuç bağlacıdır.

q: The robot arm was made of aluminium ---- it would be light enough to move quickly.
explain: Amaç + would: so that.

q: The project was launched with the aim of ---- the energy efficiency of public buildings.
explain: With the aim of + Ving: improving. 'of' edattır.

q: The data were collected over ten years; ----, the study provides a reliable picture of long-term trends.
explain: On yıl veri → güvenilir tablo: as a result. Even so/however zıtlık.

q: Divers ascend slowly ---- nitrogen bubbles should form in their blood.
explain: lest + should + V1 = -mesin diye. so that olumsuzluk olmadan anlamı ters çevirir; in case of isim ister.
tip: lest kendisi olumsuz anlam taşır; ayrıca not gerekmez.

q: Pure aluminium melts ---- a temperature of about 660 °C.
explain: Temperature, rate, speed, level, pressure ile 'at' kullanılır: at a temperature of.

q: The glacier is retreating ---- a rate of nearly forty metres a year.
explain: 'at a rate of' kalıbı. With a rate de yanlış eşdizim.

q: Carbon dioxide in the atmosphere is now ---- its highest level for at least 800,000 years.
explain: 'at its highest level' kalıbı.
tip: Level → at a level / at its highest level.

q: In terms ---- energy density, petrol is still far ahead of most batteries.
explain: 'in terms of' sabit kalıp.

q: The collapse of the roof was due ---- the weight of the snow.
explain: 'be due to' kalıbı.
tip: due to / owing to / thanks to → TO.

q: Repeated heating and cooling can lead ---- small cracks in the welded joints.
explain: 'lead to + isim' kalıbı; result in ile karıştırma.
tip: lead to / contribute to / give rise to.

q: Excessive use of fertilisers often results ---- the pollution of nearby rivers.
explain: Neden → sonuç: result in. Result from nedeni gösterir (ters yön).
tip: result in = sonuç; result from = neden.

q: Most of the damage resulted ---- the fire that followed the earthquake, not from the shaking itself.
explain: Hasar → yangından kaynaklandı: result from (neden). 'not from' ipucu.

q: Water consists ---- two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
explain: 'consist of' kalıbı. Consist in başka anlam (-de yatmak).
tip: consist of = be composed of = be made up of.

q: The success of the treatment depends largely ---- how early the disease is diagnosed.
explain: 'depend on' kalıbı.

q: Workers who are exposed ---- high noise levels for years may lose part of their hearing.
explain: 'be exposed to' kalıbı.

q: The new material is highly resistant ---- corrosion, even in salty water.
explain: 'resistant to' kalıbı.

q: Coastal cities are particularly vulnerable ---- rising sea levels.
explain: 'vulnerable to' kalıbı.

q: The authors attribute the sudden drop in fish numbers ---- a combination of warming and overfishing.
explain: 'attribute A to B' kalıbı.

q: Ozone protects living organisms ---- harmful ultraviolet radiation.
explain: 'protect A from B' kalıbı.

q: Zinc coatings prevent steel ---- rusting in humid conditions.
explain: 'prevent A from Ving' kalıbı.

q: The two methods differ mainly ---- the way the samples are heated.
explain: 'differ in' (bakımından farklı olmak); 'differ from' karşılaştırılan şey.

q: The gas is stored ---- high pressure in steel cylinders.
explain: 'under pressure' kalıbı (basınç altında). On/by/over pressure ile eşdizim kurmaz.
tip: under (high) pressure; at a pressure of + sayı.

q: The study focused ---- the long-term effects of microplastics on marine life.
explain: 'focus on' kalıbı.

q: Light travels ---- a speed of nearly 300,000 kilometres per second.
explain: 'at a speed of' kalıbı.

q: The number of cases rose ---- 15 per cent last year, reaching a total of 4,000.
explain: Artış miktarı 'by' ile: rose by 15%. 'at' sabit seviye için.
tip: increase/rise/fall BY + miktar; TO + son değer.

q: Fossil fuels still account ---- about 80 per cent of the world's energy supply.
explain: 'account for' (oluşturmak / açıklamak).

q: The lifespan of a battery is closely related ---- the number of charging cycles.
explain: 'be related to' kalıbı.

q: Titanium is a metal ---- is both light and very strong.
explain: Cansız isim (metal) + özne konumunda boşluk: which. Who insan için, what öncül almaz.

q: Marie Curie, ---- research on radioactivity won two Nobel Prizes, was born in Warsaw.
explain: Sahiplik (onun araştırması): whose + isim.

q: The laboratory ---- the first vaccine was developed is now a museum.
explain: Boşluktan sonra tam cümle (the vaccine was developed) ve öncül yer: where.
tip: Ardındaki cümle tamsa (eksik öğe yoksa) where/when.

q: Silicon, ---- is the second most abundant element in the Earth's crust, is used in computer chips.
explain: Virgüllü (non-defining) yapıda that kullanılmaz: which.

q: The engineer to ---- the report was sent did not reply for two weeks.
explain: Edattan sonra insan için whom; edattan sonra that ve who gelmez.

q: The temperature at ---- water boils depends on air pressure.
explain: Edat (at) + which; edattan sonra that gelmez.

q: The researchers studied twenty patients, most of ---- had been treated with the new drug.
explain: 'most of + whom' (insanlar). 'them' iki cümleyi bağlamaz; that/who edat sonrası olmaz.
tip: most of / some of / none of + whom/which.

q: The team tested several alloys, none of ---- could withstand temperatures above 900 °C.
explain: Cansız (alloys) için none of which. 'them' bağlaç olmadan iki cümleyi bağlayamaz.
tip: Virgülden sonra 'of them' görürsen bağlaç var mı bak.

q: The year ---- the transistor was invented marked the start of modern electronics.
explain: Öncül zaman (year) + tam cümle: when.

q: People ---- work night shifts often suffer from sleep problems.
explain: İnsan öncülü + özne boşluğu: who.

q: The reason ---- the bridge collapsed has not yet been fully explained.
explain: Öncül 'reason' + tam cümle: why.

q: ---- is most surprising about the result is how quickly the cells recovered.
explain: Öncülü olmayan, 'şey ki' anlamlı yapı: What.
tip: Öncül yoksa ve 'şey' anlamı varsa what.

q: This is the only material ---- can survive the high temperatures inside the reactor.
explain: Cansız öncül (material) + özne boşluğu: that. What öncül almaz; where yer için ve tam cümle ister.
tip: the only / the first / superlative / all → THAT.

q: The method, ---- was first used in the 1950s, is still common in hospitals.
explain: Virgüllü yapı + cansız öncül: which. That virgülle kullanılmaz.

q: The scientists observed a process ---- light energy is converted into chemical energy.
explain: Ardından tam cümle var ve 'süreç ki onunla' anlamı: whereby (= by which).

q: Several volcanoes, some of ---- are still active, lie along the coast.
explain: Cansız + some of which. 'them' bağlaçsız kullanılamaz.

q: The device measures the speed ---- the blood flows through the arteries.
explain: 'speed' 'at' ister ve ardından tam cümle var: at which.
tip: Öncülün edatı ilgi zamirinin önüne gelir: at which.

q: The students ---- results were highest received a scholarship.
explain: Sahiplik (their results): whose.

q: Engineers rejected the first design, ---- surprised the manufacturer.
explain: Önceki cümlenin tamamını niteleyen virgüllü which. That/what virgüllü kullanılamaz.

q: The village ---- they built the first wind farm has become energy independent.
explain: Ardından tam cümle var: yer için in which (= where).

q: Engineers began ---- new uses for steam engines in the nineteenth century.
explain: Begin + to V veya Ving alır; şıklarda uygun olan to find.

q: With new factories ---- across the region, demand for coal rose rapidly.
explain: With + isim + Ving (aktif, eşzamanlı eylem): appearing. Appear geçişsiz, pasifi olmaz.

q: With most of the samples ---- by the flood, the team had to restart the experiment.
explain: With + isim + V3 (pasif): örnekler yok edildi.
tip: Nesne eylemi yapmıyorsa with + N + V3.

q: Saving energy at home often means ---- habits rather than buying new devices.
explain: Mean + Ving = anlamına gelmek. Mean + to V = niyet etmek.
tip: mean + Ving: 'demek'; mean to V: 'niyet etmek'.

q: The researchers meant ---- the trial in spring, but the equipment arrived late.
explain: Niyet (planlamışlardı): mean + to V.

q: Most patients avoided ---- salty food after the diagnosis.
explain: Avoid + Ving.
tip: avoid, enjoy, finish, keep, consider + Ving.

q: The company decided ---- the old factory with a solar plant.
explain: Decide + to V.
tip: decide, plan, aim, hope, fail, manage + to V.

q: The sensor is capable of ---- changes as small as one millionth of a metre.
explain: Edat (of) + Ving.

q: Scientists stopped ---- the chemical after it was found to be toxic.
explain: Stop + Ving = yapmayı bırakmak. Stop + to V = bir şeyi yapmak için durmak (anlamı bozar).
tip: stop Ving: bırakmak; stop to V: -mek için durmak.

q: Researchers are used to ---- long hours in the laboratory.
explain: 'be used to' (alışık olmak) + Ving; 'to' edattır.
tip: be used to + Ving; used to + V1 (eskiden).

q: The first steam engines used ---- large amounts of coal.
explain: 'used to + V1' = eskiden yapardı. Be olmadığından Ving gelmez.

q: The new rules force factories ---- their waste before releasing it.
explain: Force + nesne + to V.

q: A sudden change in temperature can cause the glass ----.
explain: Cause + nesne + to V.

q: Proper ventilation lets the hot air ---- through the roof.
explain: Let + nesne + V1 (to almaz).

q: The workers remember ---- a loud bang just before the tank failed.
explain: Remember + Ving = geçmişte yapılanı hatırlamak.
tip: remember Ving: geçmiş; remember to V: yapmayı unutmamak.

q: It is important ---- protective glasses when using a laser.
explain: It is + sıfat + to V.

q: Instead of ---- the metal, the engineers cooled it rapidly in oil.
explain: Instead of (edat) + Ving.
tip: instead of / apart from / besides + Ving.

q: The team succeeded in ---- the first stable sample of the new compound.
explain: Succeed in + Ving.
tip: succeed in, persist in, insist on + Ving.

q: The probe is too small ---- by ordinary radar.
explain: Too + sıfat + to V; prob tespit edilir (pasif): to be detected.
tip: too ... to V; pasif anlamı kontrol et.

q: The material is strong enough ---- the weight of a truck.
explain: Sıfat + enough + to V.

q: Since the first satellite was launched in 1957, thousands of others ---- into orbit.
explain: Since + geçmiş zaman → ana cümle present perfect: have been sent.

q: By the time the fire brigade arrived, the flames ---- to the upper floors.
explain: By the time + Past → ana cümle Past Perfect: had spread.
tip: by the time + Past → had V3.

q: By 2040, electric cars ---- most petrol cars on European roads.
explain: By + gelecek tarih → Future Perfect: will have replaced.
tip: by + gelecek tarih → will have V3.

q: Water ---- at 100 °C at sea level.
explain: Genel bilimsel gerçek → Simple Present.

q: In 1928, Alexander Fleming ---- that mould could kill bacteria.
explain: Belirli geçmiş tarih (1928) → Simple Past.

q: The engineers ---- the bridge for three hours when they discovered the crack.
explain: Geçmişte bir eylemden önce süregelen eylem: Past Perfect Continuous.
tip: for + süre + when + Past → had been Ving.

q: Over the past two decades, the price of solar panels ---- dramatically.
explain: 'Over the past two decades' → bugüne uzanan süre, Present Perfect.
tip: over/in the past/last + süre → has V3.

q: As soon as the results ---- available, they will be published online.
explain: Zaman bağlacı (as soon as) + gelecek anlamı → Simple Present.

q: Until the telescope was invented, people ---- that the Milky Way was made of stars.
explain: Geçmişte bir noktaya kadar süren durum: Simple Past (did not know). Present perfect geçmişte kapanmış dönemle kullanılmaz.
tip: Geçmişte biten dönem → Past Simple / Past Perfect.

q: At present, scientists ---- the effects of microplastics on human health.
explain: 'At present' → Present Continuous.
tip: at present / currently / nowadays → am/is/are Ving.

q: When the probe reaches Jupiter next year, it ---- for nearly six years.
explain: Gelecekte bir ana kadar tamamlanmış süre: Future Perfect.
tip: Gelecek an + 'for süre' → will have V3.

q: The ancient Egyptians ---- simple levers and ramps to move huge blocks of stone.
explain: Antik dönem, bitmiş geçmiş → Simple Past.

q: Researchers ---- the new drug for five years, and the trials are still continuing.
explain: Geçmişte başlayıp hâlâ süren eylem (still continuing): Present Perfect Continuous.

q: Penicillin ---- by Alexander Fleming in 1928.
explain: Özne (penicillin) eylemi yapmaz + by + geçmiş tarih: was discovered.

q: Thousands of new chemicals ---- every year, but only a few are tested for safety.
explain: Kimyasallar üretilir (pasif) + her yıl (geniş zaman): are produced.

q: The new bridge ---- by the end of next year.
explain: By + gelecek → future perfect; köprü tamamlanır (pasif).

q: The samples ---- carefully before they were sent to the laboratory.
explain: Gönderilmeden önce (geçmişten önce) + pasif: had been cleaned.

q: The cause of the disease is still ----.
explain: Hâlâ araştırılıyor: is being investigated (present continuous pasif).
tip: still + süren pasif → is being V3.

q: Concrete ---- for thousands of years as a building material.
explain: Binlerce yıldır (süre) + kullanılır (pasif): has been used.
tip: for + süre + pasif → has been V3.

q: The data are believed ---- by a software error last month.
explain: 'are believed' + geçmişte olmuş pasif olay: to have been corrupted.
tip: is said/believed + to have been V3 = geçmiş pasif.

q: It ---- that the universe is about 13.8 billion years old.
explain: It is estimated that ... kalıbı (pasif).

q: The heat shield must ---- before every launch.
explain: Modal + be + V3 (pasif).

q: Most smartphones ---- in Asia.
explain: Telefonlar üretilir (pasif, genel durum).

q: The theory, which ---- for decades, was finally confirmed by satellite data.
explain: Doğrulanmadan önce (geçmişten önce) on yıllarca sorgulanmıştı: had been questioned.
tip: Ana cümle geçmişse, önceki süre → had been V3.

q: The results of the study ---- next month in a leading journal.
explain: Gelecek ay + yayımlanacak (pasif): will be published.

q: Old batteries should not ---- with household waste.
explain: Modal + be + V3 (pasif phrasal verb).

q: If the temperature falls below 0 °C, water ----.
explain: Zero conditional (bilimsel gerçek): If + present, present.

q: If the engineers had checked the cables, the collapse ----.
explain: Type 3: If + had V3, would/could have V3.

q: If we used more renewable energy, carbon emissions ---- much lower.
explain: Type 2: If + V2, would + V1.

q: Unless the patient ---- treatment soon, the infection may spread.
explain: Unless = if not; koşul cümlesinde present.

q: Many researchers wish they ---- more funding for basic science.
explain: Şimdiki bir dilek: wish + V2.
tip: wish + V2 = şimdi; wish + had V3 = geçmiş.

q: The team wishes it ---- the experiment before the equipment broke down.
explain: Geçmişe yönelik pişmanlık: wish + had V3.

q: ---- the satellite not been repaired, the mission would have failed.
explain: Devrik Type 3: Had + özne + V3 (= If the satellite had not been repaired).

q: ---- there be a power failure, the backup generator will start automatically.
explain: Devrik Type 1: Should + özne + V1 (= If there is). 'be' yalın olduğundan If değil Should.

q: ---- the Earth closer to the Sun, its oceans would boil away.
explain: Devrik Type 2: Were + özne (= If the Earth were).

q: The material will not crack ---- it is heated too quickly.
explain: Isıtma hızlı OLMADIKÇA çatlamaz: unless. If/provided that/as long as/only if anlamı tersine çevirir.
tip: Unless = if ... not; mantığı ters çevirerek dene.

q: The device works well ---- it is kept dry.
explain: Kuru tutulduğu sürece çalışır: as long as.

q: It is high time the government ---- stricter rules on plastic waste.
